licoes.objectivo: Usar adjectivos graduáveis e não graduáveis com os intensificadores certos.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: The concert was [absolutely] brilliant.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: The food was [extremely] good.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: I'm [totally] exhausted after the trip.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: The film was [quite] funny at the start, but the ending was awful.

exercicios.enunciado: Choose the correct sentence.

opcoes.texto: The hotel was a bit huge.

exercicios.enunciado: Choose the correct sentence.
"Hilarious" means…
"The food was quite good." The speaker thinks the food was…
O concerto foi absolutamente fantástico.

exercicios.frase: I'm Elsa. It was completely full. Two thousand people, and the sound was perfect.
exercicios.enunciado: How many people were at the concert?

exercicios.frase: This is Elsa. The film was quite funny at the start, but the ending was awful. Really disappointing.
exercicios.enunciado: What did Elsa think of the ending?

exercicios.frase: It was absolutely brilliant.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita, com o acento em "absolutely" e a voz animada.
Tell me about the best and the worst event, film or concert of your last year. Use at least three graded adjectives and three extreme ones, with the right intensifiers.
exercicios.frase: absolutely
exercicios.resposta: The best was my cousin's wedding in Lubango: absolutely fantastic. The food was extremely good, and the band was brilliant. The worst was a film I saw in March: quite boring and really long. By the end, I was completely exhausted.

exercicios.enunciado: Do you trust what other people say about a film or a restaurant, or do you prefer to decide for yourself? Why?
exercicios.frase: because
exercicios.resposta: I listen to friends, because they know my taste. But I don't trust online ratings much: some reviews are fake, and some people complain about everything. In the end, I prefer to decide for myself.

licoes.objectivo: Comentar com advérbios de frase e pôr os adjectivos pela ordem certa.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: [Surprisingly], the food was cheap. I expected it to be expensive.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: [Unfortunately], they only have six rooms free, and we need eight.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: a [lovely old colonial] building

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: a [small Portuguese fish] restaurant

exercicios.enunciado: "Apparently, the chef left last month." The speaker…

opcoes.texto: is sure, because he is the chef

exercicios.enunciado: Choose the correct order.
"Frankly, it's overpriced." The speaker is…
"Hopefully, you'll get a table on the terrace." This means…

opcoes.texto: I hope you will get a table.
You will certainly get a table.

exercicios.enunciado: Felizmente, são amigos.

exercicios.frase: I'm Nuno. Listen to this review: surprisingly good value. The rooms are small, but clean, and the staff are absolutely lovely.
exercicios.enunciado: What does the review say about the rooms?

exercicios.frase: This is Nuno. Frankly, overpriced. Apparently, the chef left last month.
exercicios.enunciado: Why is the restaurant bad now, apparently?

exercicios.frase: Surprisingly, the food was cheap. Unfortunately, they only have six rooms.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita, com uma pausa e o tom certo depois de cada advérbio.
Review out loud a hotel, a restaurant or a shop you know: what kind of place it is (two or three adjectives in order), three comment adverbs, and a rating out of five.
exercicios.frase: Unfortunately
exercicios.resposta: Last month I tried a lovely little Cape Verdean restaurant in Maianga. Surprisingly, it's very cheap for the area. The cachupa was absolutely delicious. Unfortunately, it's tiny, so you have to book. Apparently, it's full every Friday. Four stars out of five.

exercicios.enunciado: Do you write online reviews? Should people only write when something goes wrong? Why?
exercicios.frase: because
exercicios.resposta: I write one sometimes, usually when a place surprises me. People should write good reviews too, because otherwise small businesses only get the angry ones. A short, honest review helps everyone.

licoes.objectivo: Reagir às opiniões e notícias dos outros no registo informal.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: I'm not [that] bothered about football, to be honest.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: I don't mind [either] way.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: Oh no, [poor] you!

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: My team are playing in the final. — [Are] they?

exercicios.enunciado: Your friend says: "I've just got a new job in Lisbon!" You say:
Your colleague says: "My car broke down on the way here." You say:
Your friend says: "Traffic is getting worse every year." You agree:
Which reaction can sound rude, especially with a flat voice?
Para ser sincera, não me interessa muito.
exercicios.resposta: To be honest, I'm not that bothered.

exercicios.frase: I'm Elsa. I'm not that bothered about football, to be honest. I'm going to the beach and having a lie-in.
exercicios.enunciado: What is Elsa doing this weekend?

opcoes.texto: going to the beach and sleeping late

exercicios.frase: This is Paulo. By the way, did you hear? Mariana Kambundo is singing at the festival on Saturday night.
exercicios.enunciado: What is Paulo's news?

opcoes.texto: Mariana Kambundo is singing at the festival.
Elsa is singing at the festival.

exercicios.frase: Great! Great? Great.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita: entusiasmo, surpresa e ironia.

React to my four pieces of news, each with a short reaction and a follow-up question: I went to a fantastic concert last night. My phone was stolen at the end. Luckily, I'd backed it up. Next week I'm going to Cape Verde.
exercicios.frase: Really
exercicios.resposta: Really? Who was playing? — Oh no, poor you! Did you call the police? — That's lucky! At least you didn't lose your photos. — Lucky you! How long are you going for?

exercicios.enunciado: In your culture, is it rude to say "I'm not interested" about something a friend loves? How do you say it politely?
exercicios.frase: because
exercicios.resposta: A little, yes, because it can sound like you don't care about your friend. I'd say something like: "It's not really my thing, but I'm glad you enjoy it." That way, it's about me, not about them.

exercicios.enunciado: Ligue cada expressão à tradução.

exercicios.explicacao: Falso amigo: spectacle = cena impressionante; spectacles = óculos.

exercicios.enunciado: "Everyone says it's great, but it isn't." The film is…
"It was… interesting," said slowly and flatly, often means…

exercicios.frase: I'm Bento. Absolutely incredible! Mariana Kambundo was the best thing I've ever seen. Ten out of ten!
exercicios.enunciado: How does Bento rate the concert?

exercicios.frase: It was interesting!
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita com entusiasmo: a voz alta e larga.
Review an event, a restaurant or a product you tried recently. Would you recommend it?
exercicios.frase: recommend
exercicios.resposta: Last month I went to a jazz gig at a small venue in Ilha. The last band was absolutely brilliant: they got a standing ovation. Unfortunately, the sound was rather bad at the back. It didn't completely live up to my expectations, but I'd still recommend it.

exercicios.enunciado: Is there a famous film, book or band that you think is overrated? Why?
exercicios.frase: overrated
exercicios.resposta: I think some famous superhero films are overrated. They're entertaining, but the stories are predictable, and the endings are always the same. I prefer smaller films with real people.

licoes.objectivo: Seguir quatro opiniões à saída de um festival e identificar a opinião e o tom de cada pessoa.

exercicios.frase: I'm Bento. When she sang Mar de Areia, the whole crowd was singing. I had tears in my eyes.
exercicios.enunciado: What happened when she sang "Mar de Areia"?

exercicios.frase: I'm Fatou. Unfortunately, the organisation was rather poor. We queued forty minutes for food.
exercicios.enunciado: How long did Fatou queue for food?

exercicios.frase: This is Fatou. I'd come back next year, if they fix the queues. The music deserves a better festival.
exercicios.enunciado: What does Fatou want the festival to fix?

exercicios.frase: I'm Mr Clarke. Oh, enormously. I particularly enjoyed standing behind a very tall man for three hours.
exercicios.enunciado: What is Mr Clarke being ironic about?

opcoes.texto: standing behind a very tall man

exercicios.frase: This is Mr Clarke. The internet died just when everybody wanted to film the main concert. Typical!
exercicios.enunciado: What went wrong during the main concert?

exercicios.frase: I'm Kiala. The solar zone was cool, though: free charging, and you could sit in the shade.
exercicios.enunciado: What did Kiala like?

opcoes.texto: the solar zone: free charging and shade

exercicios.enunciado: Mr Clarke's tone is…
Whose opinion is the most useful for the organisers, because it is specific?

exercicios.frase: Absolutely incredible!
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita, com entusiasmo.

exercicios.frase: It was OK. I'm not that bothered.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita, com indiferença.
Tell a colleague what each of the four people thought, and how they said it. Which opinion is most useful for the organisers?
exercicios.frase: ironic
exercicios.resposta: Bento was enthusiastic: Mariana Kambundo was absolutely incredible. Fatou loved the music but criticised the queues. Mr Clarke was ironic: the music was lovely, but the internet died during the concert. Kiala didn't care much, but liked the solar zone. Fatou's opinion is the most useful.

exercicios.enunciado: When you give your opinion about something a friend organised, do you say what you really think? Why?
exercicios.frase: because
exercicios.resposta: Mostly yes, but kindly, because a friend wants to improve. I start with what was good, and then I say one thing to change. If it's too late to change anything, I just say I had a great time.

Give feedback on an event you organised or attended twice: first to a friend (informal, with strong adjectives), then to your manager or a sponsor (formal, with one problem and a recommendation).
exercicios.frase: Overall
exercicios.resposta: To a friend: "Absolutely brilliant! The speaker was hilarious, but the air conditioning died at eleven!" To my manager: "Overall, the training day was very well received. Unfortunately, the air conditioning stopped working. Next time, we need a room with a backup system."

exercicios.enunciado: Summarise these results in English, with words instead of percentages where you can: "Jantar de fim de ano (86 respostas): 92% gostaram da comida; 54% acharam a música alta demais; 26% gostariam de mudar de restaurante."
exercicios.frase: Almost
exercicios.resposta: We had eighty-six responses. Almost everyone liked the food. Just over half thought the music was too loud, and about a quarter would like a different restaurant next year.

exercicios.enunciado: Review an event, a restaurant or a product you tried recently. Would you recommend it?
exercicios.frase: would
exercicios.resposta: Last week I bought a small solar lamp for my veranda. Surprisingly, it's very bright, and it charges in one afternoon. Unfortunately, the switch feels rather cheap. All in all, it's good value for money, and I would recommend it.

exercicios.enunciado: A friend loved a film that you thought was awful. React to their opinion politely, then give yours.

exercicios.resposta: Really? I'm glad you enjoyed it. Honestly, it wasn't really my thing — I found the story completely predictable, and the ending was rather disappointing. But the music was absolutely beautiful, I agree.
